translations.web: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
translations.bsb: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”
translations.kjv: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
translations.asv: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still hold fast thine integrity? renounce God, and die.
